comment: The built-in Bible Teaching templates (v0.18.7): one starting structure per format, from the formats of v0.17. A template is a format and the points, questions or steps a new teaching starts with; the titles are application text (studies.teaching.starts.<kind>.<key> in every language). They cannot be changed in the app; the person saves a copy to make one their own. To refine a baseline, change it here: teachings already made are never affected. See docs/user-templates-v0.18.7.md.
